욥기 33:1.content: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.

욥기 33:2.content: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.

욥기 33:3.content: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.

욥기 33:4.content: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.

욥기 33:5.content: If thou canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up.

욥기 33:6.content: Behold, I am according to thy wish in God’s stead: I also am formed out of the clay.

욥기 33:7.content: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.

욥기 33:8.content: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of thy words, saying,

욥기 33:9.content: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.

욥기 33:10.content: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,

욥기 33:11.content: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.

욥기 33:12.content: Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.

욥기 33:13.content: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.

욥기 33:14.content: For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.

욥기 33:15.content: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;

욥기 33:16.content: Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,

욥기 33:17.content: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

욥기 33:18.content: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

욥기 33:19.content: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:

욥기 33:20.content: So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.

욥기 33:21.content: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.

욥기 33:22.content: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.

욥기 33:23.content: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:

욥기 33:24.content: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.

욥기 33:25.content: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s: he shall return to the days of his youth:

욥기 33:26.content: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.

욥기 33:27.content: He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;

욥기 33:28.content: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.

욥기 33:29.content: Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man,

욥기 33:30.content: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.

욥기 33:31.content: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.

욥기 33:32.content: If thou hast any thing to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.

욥기 33:33.content: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.
